segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Federally chartered savings bank offering deposit accounts and mostly fixed-rate residential mortgage loans in the New Orleans area.
segments.evidence: The Company has a single operating segment and thus a single reporting segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on the residential and other loans the bank originates and keeps in its portfolio, and customers pay fees for banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: We typically retain in our portfolio the loans that we originate.
